Planeringsfas University of Rwanda Vaccin inkl EU-delegering

description.narrative: EU and the Embassy of Sweden have agreed on an inception phase of Rwanda-Sweden MAV Team Europe Initiative. The inception phase is expected to lead to a full contribution with the objective to strengthen capacity for vaccine development and manufacturing in Rwanda, starting in February 2025. In addition, the Embassy of Sweden have agreed on an inception phase of research on vaccine uptake to understand potential bottlenecks in vaccination. We are anticipating a full phase from fall 2025. The funding is jointly undertaken by Sida and the Canadian IDRC to the University of Rwanda in regional collaboration as well as with researchers in Canada and Sweden.

Inception phase of Rwanda-Sweden for a delegated Team Europe Initiative, MAV+, expected to lead to full contribution with the objective to strengthen capacity for vaccine development and manufacturing in Rwanda; and a planning phase of a research program at University of Rwanda for vaccine uptake and accpetance.

Planeringsfas av Rwanda-Sverige för genomförandet av Team Europe Initiative MAV+ som förväntas leda till full insats med målsättningen att stärka kapacitet för vaccinutveckling och produktion i Rwanda, samt planeringsfas med Rwandauniversitetet för att sätta upp ett projekt runt vaccinaccpetans.
